findings.suggested_fix: Replace «Hamu ya kumtafuta Mungu,» with «Shauku ya Mungu,» to preserve the source’s desire for God rather than desire to seek God.

findings.source_quote: A vivid pink flower against a blue and green background
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «Ua la waridi angavu» with «Ua la waridi ang’avu» only if referring to a rose is intended; otherwise use «Ua la waridi/ua lenye rangi ya waridi ang’avu» carefully to mean a vivid pink flower, not specifically a rose. For example: «Ua lenye rangi ya waridi ang’avu mbele ya mandhari ya samawati na kijani».
findings.translation_quote: Ua la waridi angavu mbele ya mandhari ya samawati na kijani
